name: Monstera
hook: No splits in your Monstera? Give it brighter light and time.

steps.title: Bright, indirect light
steps.tip: Place it near a bright east or west window. Harsh summer sun scorches leaves; low light means no splits.

steps.title: Water when top 2–5 cm is dry
steps.tip: Water until it drains, then let the top 2–5 cm dry. Water a little less often in winter.

steps.title: Chunky, airy mix
steps.tip: Mix potting soil with orchid bark or perlite so roots get air and never sit soggy.

steps.title: Give it a moss pole
steps.tip: Tie the stems to a moss pole. Climbing makes it grow bigger leaves with more splits.

steps.title: Cut below a node
steps.tip: Cut a stem with a node (leaf joint) and an aerial root. Root it in water, then pot it once roots are sturdy.

outro: Bright light and patient watering: those famous split leaves.
